service.description: The staff identities with a current relationship (agent, employee, member) to an internal organization the caller administers (the filtered find on UserAccountOrganization), or to organizationPartyId among them; narrowed by text (name, username, email, ignoring case), userGroupId (a current member) and state (active, ending, locked, disabled, terminated); each with its organizations in scope (others counted, never named), state and last sign-in, paged. Public identities (accounts of no internal organization) only with includePublic and ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL, labelled as site relationships. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

One identity in scope: its account fields (never a password, hash or secret), state, organizations in scope and the count of others, its dated organization relationships the caller administers, its group memberships, its factors and credentials (metadata only, the framework's get#AccountCredentials) and whether the caller may make an account-wide change (and why not). Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

An identity's access events, newest first, at most limit (50): sign-ins (UserLoginHistory, with the session each opened) and the audit log's changes of its account, group memberships and the organization relationships the caller administers, each with actor, time, reason and the session it was made in; no password, token or session secret. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

A dated relationship of a person to an internal organization the caller administers (relationshipTypeEnumId PrtEmployee by default, PrtAgent, PrtMember or PrtRepresentative): a new one from fromDate (now when empty), or with partyRelationshipId and expectedRevision its end at thruDate (now when empty). Ended rows are kept; the dates are audit-logged with the reason. Refused for an overlapping relationship of the same kind or a stale revision, and without ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL for a person with an account of no internal organization (a site identity) or one that works for an organization the caller does not administer (another organization's staff, F78). Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

An exceptional direct staff account (invitations are the default): a person (partyId, or a new one from firstName and lastName) with a relationship to an internal organization the caller administers, an account through mantle.party.PartyServices.create#PartyUserAccount with no password (the reset password reset#Password mails, unless sendReset is false, lets the user set one), and the memberships of the grant proposal (bundleGroupIdList, registered bundles the app supplies, checked and applied by the framework's AccessServices), all or nothing. An existing person who works for an organization the caller does not administer needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

An identity's account fields (emailAddress, username, ipAllowed, requirePasswordChange, locale, timeZone) at its revision (expectedRevision, get#Account's account.revision), through update#PartyUserAccount. Each is account-wide, so an identity shared with an organization the caller does not administer needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL; ipAllowed is checked against the administration path. The audit log keeps before and after with the reason. Enabling, disabling and the end date are the lifecycle's. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

A sign-in reset of an identity in scope. resetKind password (the default) sends the change-only reset password org.moqui.impl.UserServices.reset#Password mails (no password is set; the current one stays valid), for any identity in scope; factor ends factorId (invalidate#UserAuthcFactorEntry), checked against the administration path; lock releases a failed-login lock and the account's artifact velocity locks (never a permanent disable). A factor or lock reset is account-wide: an identity shared with an organization the caller does not administer needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

One staff invitation: emailAddress (an existing person's, partyId, or a new person's with firstName and lastName), an internal organization the caller administers, the relationship (relationshipTypeEnumId, PrtEmployee by default) and the grant proposal (bundleGroupIdList: registered bundles the app supplies, checked as the caller by the framework's check#GrantProposal; a privileged group or a group granting a sealed permission is refused), with an optional message and expiry (expireDays, 7, at most 30). The token is mailed when the instance can send mail (mailSent); otherwise linkPending says the caller shows the link once through reveal#InvitationLink. A pending invitation of the address to the organization is refused (resend it); a retry with the same operationKey answers the invitation it made (retried). An existing person (the one chosen, or the owner of the address's account) who works for an organization the caller does not administer, or who has an account and works for no internal organization (a site identity), needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL (IDENTITY_GLOBAL); an address of another person's account is refused (ADDRESS_IN_USE). Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

parameter.name: baseUrl
parameter.description: The site root of the link, such as https://boss.example.com; else the template's web host or its mail server's web base URL

service.description: The invitations of the organizations the caller administers (organizationPartyId among them), narrowed by text (address or name) and state (pending, accepted, revoked, expired), newest first, paged: address, person, organization, the access by name, state, expiry, sends, inviter, revision and what the caller may do. Never a token or its hash. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

A new token for a pending or expired invitation at its revision (expectedRevision), with a new expiry: the earlier token no longer matches. Mailed, or linkPending as invite#User. The proposal and invite#User's ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL rule are checked again as the caller. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.
Revoke a pending or expired invitation at its revision, with the reason audit-logged; its token then reads as no longer valid. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

The acceptance link of an invitation the instance could not mail (no mail server), once, to whoever sent or resent it, within fifteen minutes: a new token is made now and only its hash kept; linkShownDate, audited, records the showing (never the token). Refused (LINK_SHOWN) after that: a resend makes a new link. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

The token check of the token route i (/i/<token>; the framework calls it with token and routeName before anything of the page runs): every well-formed token is valid, so the page says "This invitation is no longer valid" for a spent token and an unknown one alike; routeContext is {open}. Read only.

For the holder of a token: step (invitation, factor, done or spent) and, while open, the organization, the inviter, the invited address, the access proposed by name (no group ids), the expiry, how to accept (accountMode: signedIn, wrongAccount, signIn, create), whether a factor will be asked, and on the factor step, only for the session that accepted or the account signed in, the authenticator's setup. A spent or unknown token answers step spent and message alone. Read only.

Accept an open invitation as its token's holder: the signed-in account with the invited address, or with no one signed in a new account (username, userFullName, newPassword, newPasswordVerify; the invited address, through create#PartyUserAccount) when no account has the address (else ACCOUNT_EXISTS: sign in first). The inviter's authority and each bundle are checked again, and invite#User's ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL rule for the inviter against the redeeming account's person (IDENTITY_GLOBAL); then the organization relationship, the memberships of the proposal (authorization on, so the framework's sealed and privileged EECAs decide each) and, when a bundle's group requires a factor the account lacks, an authenticator factor to confirm (step factor); all or nothing. Nothing of the request names the organization or the access. A spent token: INVITATION_SPENT, "This invitation is no longer valid".

The first code (code) of the authenticator factor an acceptance made, from the token's holder in the session that accepted (or signed in as the account), within a day of the acceptance; a wrong code counts as a failed sign-in of the account (CODE_INVALID).

What a lifecycle operation of an identity in scope would do, without doing it: the relationships and memberships that end, the credentials and live sessions it revokes (counts and metadata only), whether owned resources go to new owners (movesResources: a disable, or a removal leaving no organization; the app's participants answer which), the consequences in words, and whether it is allowed (else reasonCode and reason: SELF, IDENTITY_GLOBAL, IDENTITY_PRIVILEGED, ADMINISTRATION_PATH, NOT_A_MEMBER, ALREADY_DISABLED, NOTHING_TO_RESTORE). Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: The organization removed; for a global operation, the one it is recorded for (else the identity's first in scope)

service.description: Record a lifecycle operation of an identity in scope and run its steps, each on its own: a disable revokes the account's access (the framework's revoke#AccountAccess, its own transaction) and disables it for good, or with a future effectiveDate writes the account's terminateDate; a removal ends the relationships to the organization and, when it works for no other, signs it out and ends its memberships (authorization on, so the sealed and privileged EECAs decide each); a restore enables it and clears its end date, bringing back no credential, membership or schedule. A disable, or a removal leaving no organization, also records participantSteps (from the app's registered participants: each {providerKey, ownerApp, title, action pause or transfer, actionService, resourceParameter, resourceKind, resourceId, resourceName}): a pause runs now, a transfer waits for a new owner; a service that does not carry the owned-resource contract (org.moqui.admin.IdentityServices define#OwnedResourcePause or define#OwnedResourceTransfer) is a failed step. expectedRevision, when given, is the account's revision (get#Account); a retry with the same operationKey answers the first operation (retried). Refused as preview#Lifecycle says, or REVISION_CHANGED. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

One lifecycle operation of an organization in scope: the immutable request (target, kind, global or the organization, requester, source, reason, effective date, the account revision it named) with its state and progress, and its steps (owner, step, resource, state, attempts, reason, new owner) with what the caller may do (canRetry, canTransfer). No owner record is copied. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

The lifecycle operations of the organizations the caller administers (organizationPartyId among them), narrowed by account (userId), kind, statusId and requested date (fromDate, thruDate), newest first, paged: target, kind, scope, requester, source, state, progress, failures and what waits. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW.

Run a failed or waiting step of an operation in scope again: the account's own step (for a global operation the identity in scope and the account-wide rules again), a participant's pause, or a transfer to toUserId (an account in the caller's scope, neither the operation's nor the caller's), through the step's owner service (called with the framework's call#OwnedResourceService, so under its own authorization), which checks its own permission and the new owner. A removal's account step needs the operation's organization in scope, and the privileged rule again where it signs out or ends memberships; a disable or a membership end is checked against the administration path again. The outcome (applied, or reasonCode and reason) and the attempt are recorded; the operation's state follows its steps. expectedRevision, when given, is the step's. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

The internal organizations (OrgInternal parties) the caller administers, by the organization entity filters of the authorization the call runs under (the find on InternalOrganization), narrowed by text (name or pseudo id, ignoring case) and parentPartyId; each with its current parent and count of child organizations, paged. everyOrganization says whether the caller administers every internal organization. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW.

One internal organization in scope (another and a missing one refused alike, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): its name, pseudo id, roles and revision; its dated parent rows (ended ones kept) and child organizations; its staff and representative relationships (named for an ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW holder, else counted); and its registered defaults (the setting types of the OrgInternal role, each with its value, source, revision and whether it is changed here). Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_VIEW.

A new internal organization (PartyServices.create#Organization with the OrgInternal role) and its parent from now (store#OrganizationParent's dated PrtOrgRollup). The parent must be in scope; without one the caller must administer every internal organization (PARENT_REQUIRED). Initializes no accounting, membership, secret or currency. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

An internal organization's name and pseudo id (PartyServices.update#PartyDetail with those alone), at the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED). Refused for an organization out of scope and a pseudo id another party has. Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

The parent of an internal organization from fromDate (now when empty): a dated PrtOrgRollup relationship between two OrgInternal parties (NOT_INTERNAL otherwise), the current one ended then and kept; with no parentPartyId the current parent ends, only for a caller administering every internal organization (PARENT_REQUIRED). Both organizations in scope; the parent never the organization or one below it (PARENT_CYCLE); refused while a later parent is set (PARENT_SCHEDULED). Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

A registered default of an internal organization in scope (a setting type of the OrgInternal role) that is changed here (typed, or validated against the organization's records), at the revision read; validated by PartyServices.validate#PartySetting and stored by store#PartySetting; an empty value removes the organization's own value. Refused for an unregistered type (NOT_REGISTERED) and one its owner sets (OWNER_SETTING). Needs ADMIN_SETTINGS_MANAGE.

Whether a row (emailAddress, partyId, displayName, bundleGroupIds; organizationPartyId only as the batch's own) would be invited into the batch's organization (scopeKey) by invite#User, by the same checks and changing nothing: the organization in the caller's scope, no pending invitation of the address there, an existing identity of another organization only with ADMIN_IDENTITY_GLOBAL, and the bundles as a grant proposal (registered and delegable by the caller; never a privileged group or one granting a sealed permission). The registration's alwaysBundleGroupIds (fixedValues) are added to every row. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

One invite#User for a validated row, with the batch's options (expireDays, relationshipTypeEnumId, message) and the row's operation key, so a repeat answers the invitation it made. resultRef is the invitation. Needs ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE.

The internal organizations the caller administers (ADMIN_IDENTITY_VIEW or ADMIN_IDENTITY_MANAGE): those an import of invitations may be for and whose imports the caller may read. None without the permission.
